ownmods.inventorysort.title: Inventory sorting
ownmods.inventorysort.description: R in inventory: main inventory. In storage: storage. Shift+R: main inventory. Hotbar is preserved.
ownmods.inventorysort.enabled.tip: Sort inventory and supported storage. Singleplayer only.
ownmods.inventorysort.merge.tip: Merge only identical items with matching components.
ownmods.inventorysort.containers.tip: Chests, barrels, shulkers, hoppers, droppers and dispensers.
ownmods.inventorysort.buttons.tip: Show small sorting icons. R remains available.
ownmods.inventorysort.stale: Inventory changed or locked. Please try again.
ownmods.inventorysort.mode.tip: Click: ID → Related items → Item type → Colour → ID. Save applies the choice; it takes effect on the next sort.
ownmods.inventorysort.mode.id.tip: Alphabetical registry identifier, e.g. minecraft:oak_log, then display name. Not the numeric runtime ID.
ownmods.inventorysort.mode.family.tip: Redstone together, wood by wood family, stone by stone family, etc. Redstone function and equipment take precedence over material.
ownmods.inventorysort.mode.type.tip: Building cubes, stairs, slabs, walls, fences, bars; then swords, pickaxes, axes, hoes, shovels, seeds/crops and other item types.
ownmods.inventorysort.mode.color.tip: Fixed colour families: white/greys/black, brown and rainbow colours. Named colour variants and known material colours, not texture analysis. Unknown colours last.
